summary: Dakhla Airport (VIL/GMMH) serves the remote coastal city of Dakhla, situated on a narrow peninsula along the Atlantic coast of Western Sahara, a disputed territory largely administered by Morocco. The airport functions as the main gateway for travelers heading to this increasingly popular destination for kitesurfing, water sports, and ecotourism. With its single runway and modest terminal, it handles both domestic flights from Casablanca and seasonal international charter traffic.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines operate from Dakhla Airport?
A: Royal Air Maroc provides the primary scheduled service with regular flights to and from Casablanca, and seasonal or charter services occasionally connect to European cities such as Madrid and Las Palmas.

Q: How far is Dakhla Airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located roughly 6 kilometers north of central Dakhla, and most hotels and the main kitesurfing zones can be reached within 15 to 20 minutes by taxi.

Q: Are there currency exchange and ATM services at the airport?
A: Basic facilities are available, but services are limited. It is recommended to exchange currency or withdraw Moroccan dirhams in Casablanca or in Dakhla city before traveling onward.

Q: Is the airport terminal open 24 hours?
A: No, the terminal operates only around scheduled flight times, so passengers should confirm their arrival and departure times in advance.
transport_tips: Taxis are the most reliable way to reach Dakhla from the airport, and it is wise to agree on the fare before starting the journey since meters are uncommon. Rental cars are available from local agencies in the city and offer flexibility for exploring the peninsula and surrounding desert landscapes. Shared grand taxis to the city center are a budget-friendly option for travelers accustomed to local transport.
local_tip: Pack all kitesurfing or water sports gear in your checked luggage well in advance—rental equipment in Dakhla can sell out quickly during the windy season from March to May, and bringing your own setup ensures the best fit and quality.
